$comment: CMCR source media that are never installed or shown because they identify a patient or carry the patient's calendar dates (docs/CMCR_CASES.md, Privacy). The list applies to every CMCR collection (cmcr-20 and cmcr-105). The installer checks it first: it refuses these files and removes a copy an earlier version installed (matched by checksum); the collection tests keep them out of the cases. cmcr-105 media must in addition carry an approved entry with its sha256 in scripts/cmcr-105-media-review.json.
